source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Each time this unit gets **selected to fight** in the **[Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase)**, you may make a **[psychic roll](vsdata:core-rule/psychic-abilities)** (1 D6) for it if it isn't **[battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**. If you do:

- A 1 makes this unit **battle-shocked**.
- For the rest of that phase, its melee attacks gain **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** and **[[PSYCHIC]](vsdata:weapon-ability/psychic)**.
